candidates.source_name: Transport, freight, lorry, 3.5t-7.5t gross weight, fleet average

target.name: market for transport, freight, lorry, unspecified

candidates.rationale: Explicit coarse freight proxy: retain European tonne-kilometres and a fleet mix instead of inventing EURO-standard shares. The target mixes truck sizes and represents diesel freight; the UVEK 3.5-7.5 t weight class, payload and fleet composition are not reproduced. Not equivalent to the originally published EURO 5 service.
evidence: UVEK 2025 and ecoinvent 3.12 cut-off reference catalogs

candidates.source_name: Transport, freight, lorry, 3.5t gross weight, fleet average

target.name: market group for transport, freight, light commercial vehicle, fleet average
target.reference product: transport, freight, light commercial vehicle, fleet average

candidates.rationale: Explicit light-commercial freight proxy for the 3.5 t gross-weight fleet service. European geography and tonne-kilometre basis are retained; the target market group does not establish identical vehicle payload, utilization or fleet composition.
evidence: UVEK 2025 and ecoinvent 3.12 cut-off reference catalogs
IEA PVPS T12-33:2026 light-commercial transport source and documented native proxy

candidates.source_name: Transport, freight, lorry, 16t-32t gross weight, fleet average

target.name: market for transport, freight, lorry, unspecified

candidates.rationale: Explicit coarse geographic freight proxy: use European diesel fleet freight rather than inventing a Swiss EURO-standard distribution. Tonne-kilometres are retained, but Swiss geography, 16-32 t size class, payload and fleet composition are not reproduced. The source is the canonical full-service UVEK supplier, not the original operation-only Betrieb boundary.
evidence: UVEK 2025 and ecoinvent 3.12 cut-off reference catalogs
